commits.subject: Split law-bot into standalone Law Bot.exe with dedicated icon
commits.body:
Law bot now runs as a separate Windows tray app independent from the
main remote-cli launcher. Restarting or rebuilding rcli no longer kills
the law bot, fixing the family-bot interruption complaint.

- New law-launcher.cs: independent C# WinForms tray launcher with own
  mutex (LawBot_SingleInstance), tray menu (Start/Stop/Settings/Log/
  Auto-start/Restart/Quit), crash watch with auto-restart (max 3),
  one-shot migration from legacy bot-state.json lawBotAutoStart flag
  to HKCU\Run\LawBot registry key — existing users keep their
  auto-start setting without any reconfiguration.
- New law-app.ico: purple gradient scales-of-justice icon (multi-size
  16/32/48/64/128/256 PNG-embedded ICO) generated by make-law-icon.ps1.
  Visually distinct from the main bot orange icon.
- launcher.cs: strip all law-bot logic — fields, methods, tray submenu,
  Main() auto-start block, timer crash watch, StopBot StopLawBot call,
  splash law-bot indicator, and lawbot_* i18n keys. Net -680 LOC.
- Offline poller in law-launcher.cs: when law bot is stopped, the
  launcher itself polls Telegram getUpdates and replies to user
  messages with a maintenance notice (deduplicated per chat per
  offline session). Replaces the old StopLawBot broadcast that
  spammed all family members on every shutdown.
- setup.bat: build dist\Law Bot.exe alongside the main exe, auto-
  generate law-app.ico via PowerShell if missing.
- release.yml: add law-bot launcher build step and ship law-launcher.cs
  + law-app.ico + make-law-icon.ps1 in the release zip.
- README.md: document the new Law Bot section.

commits.author: mmoollee101-lab
commits.subject: Fix streaming message duplication and improve in-place edit UX
commits.body:
The streaming code was sending each accumulated buffer as a NEW Telegram
message instead of editing one message in place, producing 5+ growing
duplicates per response. Root cause: safeSend() did not return the
sendMessage result, so streamingMsgId stayed undefined and every
throttle tick fell into the "send new" branch.

In addition, the tool-use progress indicator was being deleted whenever
text arrived between tool calls, so each tool call after the first
created a new icon message in chat (Glob, Read, Edit popping up
separately) instead of editing one rolling indicator in place.

- safeSend(): return await bot.sendMessage(...) in both the happy path
  and the markdown-fallback path. This is the entire fix for the
  streaming duplication bug.
- runClaude(): on entering the for-await loop, immediately send a
  "🤔 생각하는 중..." message and store it as initialMsgId. The first
  text or tool-use block then repurposes that message in place, so the
  user sees instant feedback during the thinking phase instead of a
  silent typing indicator. Cleaned up at the result handler if neither
  text nor tool ever arrives.
- runClaude() text branch: stop deleting progressMsgId on text arrival.
  Subsequent tool calls now edit the existing icon message in place,
  matching the pre-v2 single-rolling-icon behavior.
- bot.js systemPrompt append: instruct rcli's Claude Code SDK to emit
  bkit Feature Usage as a one-line "📱 bkit: Tool1, Tool2" format, so
  users can visually distinguish Telegram responses (one-liner) from
  computer CLI responses (full multi-line box).

commits.author: mmoollee101-lab
commits.subject: Lock law-bot system prompt to legal topics only
commits.body:
Non-admin family users were able to ask the law bot non-legal questions
(coding help, general chat, translation) and Claude would dutifully
answer because the system prompt only described its role as a legal
expert without forbidding off-topic requests. Even though the law bot
has no general-purpose tools, it still produced text answers like
coding suggestions, which was off-mission.

Add an absolute-rule section at the very top of SYSTEM_PROMPT that
strictly scopes the bot to Korean legal information (laws, precedents,
admin rules, ordinances, legal terms, rights/duties/procedures) and
forces a fixed refusal message for everything else — including
disguised attempts like "what is the legally safest way to write this
code?". Explicitly states that the rule cannot be overridden by any
user request, including the admin, to block jailbreak attempts.

The package-lock.json delta is incidental npm install noise (libc
field removal on optional deps).

commits.author: mmoollee101-lab
commits.subject: Fix release workflow: use --legacy-peer-deps for npm install
commits.body:
The release builds for v2.0.0 and v2.1.0 failed at the npm install step
because openai@4.104.0 requires zod@^3.23.8 (peerOptional) while the
@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk transitive zod is 3.25.76. npm 10 now
treats this as a hard ERESOLVE error.

Adding --legacy-peer-deps restores npm 6 behavior (warn but install),
which is safe here since the conflict is on an optional peer dep that
both versions of zod satisfy at runtime.

Mirror the runtime separation in the distribution: produce two
independent portable zips per release tag instead of one bundled
archive. Users who only want rcli download rcli, users who only want
the law bot download law-bot, no leftover files either way.

- release.yml: install both rcli and law-bot npm dependencies, build
  both exes, then package two zips (rcli-vX.Y.Z.zip and
  law-bot-vX.Y.Z.zip) using stripped setup.bat templates from
  release_assets/.
- release_assets/rcli-setup.bat: rcli-only setup script — npm install
  at root, build Claude Telegram Bot.exe, no law-bot references.
- release_assets/law-bot-setup.bat: law-bot-only setup script — npm
  install in law-bot/, generate law-app.ico if missing, build Law
  Bot.exe.
- release_assets/law-bot-README.md: standalone README for the law-bot
  zip with quick-start, settings, security/scope, and folder layout.

The root setup.bat is unchanged and still builds both for local
development. The CI workflow uses the stripped versions only when
packaging the portable zips.

+# Law Bot ⚖️
+
+가족 모두가 쓸 수 있는 한국 법률 도우미 봇.
+한국 법령, 판례, 행정규칙을 텔레그램으로 검색해서 쉬운 한국어로 설명합니다.
+
+> 메인 [remote-cli](https://github.com/mmoollee101-lab/remote-cli) (Claude Code 텔레그램 원격 제어) 와 **완전히 독립**된 별도 트레이 앱입니다. 메인 봇을 재시작/재빌드해도 법률 봇은 영향받지 않습니다.
+
+## 🚀 빠른 시작
+
+### 사전 준비
+- [Node.js 20+](https://nodejs.org)
+- [Claude Code CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anthropic-ai/claude-code) (`npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`)
+
+### 설치
+1. zip 다운로드 후 원하는 폴더에 압축 해제
+2. `setup.bat` 더블클릭 → Node 의존성 설치 + Law Bot.exe 빌드
+3. `dist\Law Bot.exe` 더블클릭 → 시스템 트레이에 ⚖️ 보라색 아이콘 등장
+
+### 설정
+1. 트레이 아이콘 우클릭 → **설정**
+2. 입력 항목:
+   - **Telegram Bot Token**: [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) 에서 새 봇 생성 → 토큰 복사 (메인 rcli 봇과 **별도로** 만드세요)
+   - **Law API Key (OC)**: [open.law.go.kr](https://open.law.go.kr) 가입 → 마이페이지 → API 키 발급
+   - **관리자 ID**: 본인 텔레그램 유저 ID (봇에 `/start` 보내면 확인됨)
+   - **사용자 목록**: 가족 멤버 ID (`,` 로 구분, 자동 승인도 가능)
+3. 저장 → 봇 자동 재시작
+
+### 사용법
+가족이 봇에 평소 말투로 질문하면 됩니다:
+- "전세 보증금 못 받으면 어떻게 해?"
+- "교통사고 합의금 기준이 어떻게 돼?"
+- "상속 포기 절차가 어떻게 되나?"
+
+빠른 카테고리 선택은 `/category` 명령.
+
+## 🔒 보안 / 범위
+
+법률 봇은 **한국 법률 정보만** 답변합니다. 코딩 요청, 잡담, 번역, 일반 상식 등은 거절합니다 (관리자 포함).
+
+## 🛠 트레이 메뉴
+
+| 항목 | 동작 |
+|---|---|
+| 시작/중지 | 법률 봇 프로세스 제어 |
+| 설정 | 봇 토큰 / API 키 / 사용자 편집 |
+| 로그 보기 | `law-bot/law-bot.log` 열기 |
+| 자동 시작 | 윈도우 부팅 시 자동 실행 |
+| 재시작 | 봇 프로세스 재시작 |
+| 종료 | 트레이 앱 + 봇 모두 종료 |
+
+## 🔧 점검 중 메시지
+
+봇이 꺼져있을 때 사용자가 메시지를 보내면 launcher 가 직접 폴링하여 "🔧 점검 중" 회신을 한 번만 보냅니다 (사용자별 1회). 종료할 때마다 모든 사용자에게 broadcast 하지 않습니다.
+
+## 📁 폴더 구조
+
+```
+law-bot-v2.2.0/
+├── dist/
+│   └── Law Bot.exe          ← 실행 파일 (트레이 런처)
+├── law-bot/
+│   ├── law-bot.js           ← 메인 봇 코드
+│   ├── law-tools.js         ← 법제처 API 도구
+│   ├── config.js            ← 설정값 (throttle 등)
+│   ├── package.json
+│   └── node_modules/
+├── law-launcher.cs           ← 트레이 런처 C# 소스
+├── law-app.ico              ← 트레이/exe 아이콘
+├── make-law-icon.ps1        ← 아이콘 재생성 스크립트
+├── setup.bat                ← 자동 설정/빌드 스크립트
+└── README.md
+```
+
+## 🔄 메인 rcli 와 함께 쓰기
+
+같은 PC 에서 [remote-cli](https://github.com/mmoollee101-lab/remote-cli) 메인 봇과 같이 사용 가능합니다. 두 exe 는 완전히 독립된 프로세스 / 트레이 아이콘 / 텔레그램 봇 토큰을 사용하므로 서로 영향이 없습니다.
+
+## 라이선스
+
+MIT

+@echo off
+chcp 65001 >nul 2>&1
+title Law Bot - Setup
+
+echo ═══════════════════════════════════════
+echo   법률 도우미 봇 - 초기 설정
+echo ═══════════════════════════════════════
+echo.
+
+:: Check Node.js
+where node >nul 2>&1
+if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
+    echo [ERROR] Node.js가 설치되어 있지 않습니다.
+    echo   https://nodejs.org 에서 Node.js 20+ 설치 후 다시 실행하세요.
+    echo.
+    pause
+    exit /b 1
+)
+
+for /f "tokens=*" %%i in ('node -v') do set NODE_VER=%%i
+echo [OK] Node.js %NODE_VER%
+
+:: Check Claude Code CLI
+where claude >nul 2>&1
+if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
+    echo [WARN] Claude Code CLI가 설치되어 있지 않습니다.
+    echo   설치 명령: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
+    echo.
+    set /p INSTALL_CLAUDE="지금 설치하시겠습니까? (Y/N): "
+    if /i "%INSTALL_CLAUDE%"=="Y" (
+        npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
+    ) else (
+        echo   나중에 수동으로 설치하세요.
+    )
+) else (
+    echo [OK] Claude Code CLI
+)
+
+:: npm install in law-bot folder
+echo.
+echo 법률 봇 의존성 패키지 설치 중...
+pushd law-bot
+call npm install --production --legacy-peer-deps
+popd
+echo [OK] npm install 완료
+
+:: Generate icon if missing
+if not exist law-app.ico (
+    if exist make-law-icon.ps1 (
+        echo.
+        echo 법률 봇 아이콘 생성 중...
+        powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File make-law-icon.ps1 >nul 2>&1
+        if exist law-app.ico (
+            echo [OK] law-app.ico 생성 완료
+        )
+    )
+)
+
+:: Build Law Bot launcher exe
+if not exist dist mkdir dist
+echo.
+echo 법률 봇 런처 빌드 중...
+if exist law-app.ico (
+    set LAW_ICO=law-app.ico
+) else (
+    set LAW_ICO=
+)
+if defined LAW_ICO (
+    C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /nologo /target:winexe /win32icon:%LAW_ICO% /out:"dist\Law Bot.exe" law-launcher.cs >nul 2>&1
+) else (
+    C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /nologo /target:winexe /out:"dist\Law Bot.exe" law-launcher.cs >nul 2>&1
+)
+if %errorlevel% equ 0 (
+    echo [OK] dist\Law Bot.exe 빌드 완료
+) else (
+    echo [WARN] exe 빌드 실패 — node law-bot/law-bot.js 로 직접 실행하세요.
+)
+
+echo.
+echo ═══════════════════════════════════════
+echo   설정 완료!
+echo.
+echo   실행 방법:
+echo     1. dist\Law Bot.exe 더블클릭
+echo     2. 트레이 아이콘 우클릭 → 설정
+echo     3. 텔레그램 봇 토큰 + 법제처 OC 키 + 사용자 ID 입력
+echo.
+echo   법률 봇은 메인 rcli와 완전히 독립 실행됩니다.
+echo ═══════════════════════════════════════
+echo.
+pause

+        echo # 컴퓨터 이름 ^(텔레그램에 표시됨^)

+    echo.
+    echo [OK] .env 파일 생성됨
+    echo [INFO] 봇 실행 후 텔레그램에서 /start 보내면 유저 ID가 콘솔에 출력됩니다.

commits.subject: Add resilience & recovery: healthcheck, warm sessions, cross-watchdog, remote restart
commits.body:
Connection stability:
- Dead-man's-switch healthcheck (ping healthchecks.io; active getMe watchdog)
- Distinct crash exit code (83) so launcher auto-restarts real crashes
- Launcher auto-start default ON; crash backoff without permanent give-up

Law bot speed & UX:
- Warm session pool (reuse SDK subprocess): ~13s cold -> ~2-3s warm
- Pre-warmed spare + idle timeout + /new reset; cold-start notice
- Model sonnet + effort low + Telegram streaming
- Soften system prompt: allow greetings/status/help, not just legal

Remote restart & monitoring:
- law-bot restart.trigger watched by launcher
- Telegram /lawrestart, /lawbot button, main-bot down detection
- Web link restart (restart-control.js, opt-in token)
- Email trigger via IMAP (mail-trigger.js) + alert email with link (mailer.js)
- Cross-watchdog: launchers mutually restart each other's bot
- Laptop suspend/shutdown -> auto-pause healthcheck (no false alerts)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
